paper_title: Nearshore Bathymetry from ICESat-2 LiDAR and Sentinel-2 Imagery Datasets Using Physics-Informed CNN
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 571 explicitly states that Sentinel-2 Level-1C imagery products are available at the exact EarthExplorer URL in its Data Availability Statement and describes downloading less-than-10-percent-cloud L1C imagery from the USGS website for the study. Current USGS documentation independently verifies EarthExplorer and Sentinel-2 Level-1C product access. PRL000176 is verified.
